headline.purpose: Section and match titles that anchor dense evidence regions.

title.purpose: Identity-level titles such as the small brand wordmark.

body.purpose: Readable event summaries, field content, and explanatory copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels, replay labels, and docket annotations.

data.purpose: Tabular versions, plies, clocks, record ids, counts, and trace phases.

shadows.purpose: Keeps the sticky tournament-green header distinct from content moving beneath it.

shadows.name: board-object
shadows.purpose: Gives the physical chessboard the interface's sole substantial lift.

shadows.name: live-signal
shadows.purpose: Provides a compact glow for the local live environment indicator.

motion.name: live-radio-sweep

components.name: Primary Match Button
components.description: Starts the selected backend-authored match from the docket.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>Start mock match</button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:42px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:8px; color:#fffdf7; background:var(--green, #244c40); font-family:var(--font-ledger, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size:12px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-primary svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--green-raised, #316657); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Stop Active Button
components.description: The compact destructive action that sits beside live match status.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-stop" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><rect x="9" y="9" width="6" height="6" rx="1"/></svg>Stop active</button>
components.css: .ds-button-stop { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; min-height:32px; padding:0 9px; border:0; border-radius:7px; color:var(--rust-deep, #7e2f24); background:#ead4cc; font-family:var(--font-ledger, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size:10px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-stop svg { width:15px; height:15px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; } .ds-button-stop:hover { color:#fff9f5; background:var(--rust, #a34131); } .ds-button-stop:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button-stop:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Harness Select
components.description: Selects a versioned harness while keeping version identity visible.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:7px; min-width:220px; color:var(--ink-soft, #53615b); font-family:var(--font-ledger, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field select { width:100%; min-height:42px; padding:0 34px 0 11px; border:1px solid var(--rule-dark, #68736d); border-radius:8px; color:var(--ink, #1c2723); background:#fffdf7; font-family:"Segoe UI Variable", Aptos, sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:650; text-transform:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-field select:hover { border-color:var(--green, #244c40); } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Running Status Badge
components.description: Pairs a live radio glyph with explicit running text.
components.html: Running
components.css: .ds-status-running { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:5px 9px; border-radius:999px; color:#174434; background:#cae4d4; font-family:var(--font-ledger, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size:10px; font-weight:850; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-status-running svg { width:13px; height:13px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; } .ds-status-running:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, #cae4d4 78%, var(--green, #244c40)); } .ds-status-running:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ledger Surface
components.description: The ruled vellum container used for dockets, status, traces, and records.
components.html:
Match docket

Backend-authored record

Position, notation, and causal trace stay in one evidence system.
components.css: .ds-ledger-surface { max-width:360px; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--rule, #a8aea7); border-radius:12px; color:var(--ink, #1c2723); background:var(--paper, #f5f1e7); } .ds-ledger-surface > span { color:var(--green, #244c40); font-family:ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-ledger-surface h3 { margin:7px 0 0; font-family:var(--font-ledger, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size:19px; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-ledger-surface p { margin:7px 0 0; color:var(--ink-soft, #53615b); font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; } .ds-ledger-surface:hover { border-color:var(--rule-dark, #68736d); } .ds-ledger-surface:focus-within { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Replay Cursor
components.description: The rust registration diamond that synchronizes the active ply across the record.
components.css: .ds-replay { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(140px, 1fr) auto; gap:10px; align-items:center; min-width:320px; color:var(--ink-soft, #53615b); font-family:var(--font-ledger, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-replay input { width:100%; height:4px; border-radius:0; appearance:none; accent-color:var(--rust, #a34131); background:#aeb5b0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-replay input::-webkit-slider-thumb { width:14px; height:14px; border:0; border-radius:2px; appearance:none; background:var(--rust, #a34131); transform:rotate(45deg); } .ds-replay input::-moz-range-thumb { width:14px; height:14px; border:0; border-radius:2px; background:var(--rust, #a34131); transform:rotate(45deg); } .ds-replay input:hover { background:var(--rule-dark, #68736d); } .ds-replay input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-replay output { min-width:42px; font-family:ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-weight:400; text-align:right; letter-spacing:0; }

components.name: Active Decision Trace Event
components.description: A ruled trace row whose active marker shares the replay registration geometry.
components.css: .ds-trace-event { display:grid; grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0, 1fr); gap:7px; width:100%; max-width:500px; padding:13px 15px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #d4d0c4; color:var(--ink, #1c2723); background:var(--green-wash, #dbe8df); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-trace-event:hover { background:#cfded5; } .ds-trace-event:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-trace-marker { display:grid; width:20px; height:20px; margin-top:1px; border:1px solid var(--rust-deep, #7e2f24); border-radius:2px; place-items:center; color:#fffdf7; background:var(--rust, #a34131); transform:rotate(45deg); } .ds-trace-marker svg { width:13px; height:13px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; transform:rotate(-45deg); } .ds-trace-copy { display:grid; gap:5px; } .ds-trace-copy > span { color:var(--green, #244c40); font-family:ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size:9px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-trace-copy strong { font-size:13px; line-height:1.3; } .ds-trace-copy small { color:var(--ink-soft, #53615b); font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; }

components.name: Selected History Record
components.description: A selected match ledger row with tabular identity and an explicit result chip.
components.css: .ds-history-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(120px, .8fr) minmax(260px, 2fr) auto 20px; gap:18px; align-items:center; width:100%; min-height:58px; padding:10px 16px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #d4d0c4; color:var(--ink, #1c2723); background:var(--green-wash, #dbe8df); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-history-row:hover { background:#cfded5; } .ds-history-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #0a67a3) 65%, white); outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-history-id { color:var(--green, #244c40); font-family:ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:2px; text-underline-offset:4px; } .ds-history-players { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap:8px; align-items:baseline; font-size:12px; } .ds-history-players strong { font-family:var(--font-ledger, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); } .ds-history-players small { color:var(--ink-soft, #53615b); font-family:ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size:9px; } .ds-history-players em { color:var(--ink-soft, #53615b); font-family:Georgia, serif; } .ds-history-result { padding:4px 7px; border-radius:999px; color:#174434; background:#cae4d4; font-family:ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; } .ds-history-row > svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:var(--green, #244c40); stroke-width:2; }

components.name: Changed Board Cell
components.description: A square board cell carrying the same rust registration used by replay and trace.
components.css: .ds-board-mini { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 64px); overflow:hidden; width:max-content; border:4px solid #34443d; border-radius:4px; box-shadow:0 16px 28px rgb(35 48 42 / 22%); } .ds-board-mini span { position:relative; display:block; width:64px; aspect-ratio:1; background:var(--white-square, #e7dbc2); } .ds-board-mini .ds-dark { background:var(--black-square, #567769); } .ds-board-mini .ds-changed::after { position:absolute; inset:8%; border:3px solid var(--rust, #a34131); content:""; pointer-events:none; } .ds-board-mini:hover .ds-changed::after { border-color:var(--rust-deep, #7e2f24); }

narrative.overview:
The Arbiter's Ledger treats every position, notation, and causal trace as one signed record. Its visual world is calm but unmistakable: vellum sheets sit on a cool desk, graphite rules turn dense evidence into a readable register, tournament green establishes authority, and rust marks the exact place where attention or intervention is required.

The system is flat, compact, and documentary rather than game-like. Square board cells, ruled rows, tabular annotations, and restrained type create the feeling of a working tournament desk; tonal shifts carry hierarchy while rare registration marks keep the current ply visible across the record. It explicitly refuses the detached board-plus-generic-dashboard pattern.
keyCharacteristics: Vellum surfaces on a cool neutral desk
Tournament green authority with rust registration marks
Graphite rules, square ledger cells, and compact tabular evidence
Position, notation, and causal trace treated as one synchronized record
Flat tonal layering with narrowly reserved shadows

rules.name: The Registration Rule
rules.body: Rust is a locating device, not decoration: use it for the active move, an intervention, or a failed state, and keep routine actions green or neutral.

rules.name: The Evidence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Prose explains; Archivo labels; monospace proves. Do not use decorative type to imitate chess culture.

rules.name: The Adjacency Rule
rules.body: On investigative surfaces, keep the artifact under inspection and the evidence that explains it adjacent when space permits; when they stack, preserve their causal reading order.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and graphite rules for ordinary hierarchy; do not add shadow to routine cards, rows, inputs, or buttons.

rules.name: The Registration Geometry Rule
rules.body: A rust diamond means “this exact point in the record”; keep that silhouette consistent across notation, replay, and trace.

dos: Do use paper and green washes to separate regions before adding elevation.
Do keep version identifiers, plies, clocks, and event metadata tabular and compact.
Do use rust to register the active move, destructive action, or failed state.
Do preserve a visible focus outline and pair every status color with text.
Do keep position, notation, and trace synchronized when a replay cursor is present.
donts: Don't turn the product into a generic card dashboard detached from the chess position.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, ornamental textures, or casual game styling.
Don't scatter shadows across routine surfaces; reserve them for the header, board, and live dot.
Don't use rounded softness everywhere; preserve square cells, ruled rows, and compact controls.
Don't infer human move controls or editable agent behavior from spectator data.
